typePolicy.sqliteAffinity: Preserve source TEXT / INTEGER / REAL / BLOB unless explicitly transformed/omitted.
typePolicy.boolean: INTEGER 0/1 + CHECK; no BOOLEAN storage type.
typePolicy.timestamps: Preserve source TEXT ISO-UTC vs INTEGER epoch-ms; no blanket conversion.
typePolicy.json: TEXT with canonical serialization and field-specific recursive allowlist.
typePolicy.digests: Explicit algorithm/domain/version; a hash/digest/checksum name alone is insufficient.
typePolicy.constraints: PK/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK/index/trigger parity remains a separate D1 compatibility test gate.

R-EMAIL-EXT.reason: Direct contact PII; keep raw value in separately approved PII custody, not D1/Worker payload/logs.

R-MESSAGE-EXT.reason: Free-text PII; keep raw message in separately approved PII custody.

R-SUBSCRIPTION-URL-EXT.reason: Secret-bearing subscription URL; never enter D1, Worker payloads, or logs.

R-TOTP-EXT.reason: Even encrypted TOTP blobs remain outside D1; retain credential identity/status/counters only.

R-PAYMENT-ACTION-EXT.reason: Provider action URL may contain bearer/signed query data; use short-lived custody.

R-LEGACY-CHECKOUT-EXT.reason: Legacy checkout URL may be an active payment capability.

R-LEGACY-QR-EXT.reason: QR payload may encode a payment capability.

R-LEASE-DIGEST.reason: Replace raw short-lived capability with a domain-separated digest; preserve generation, expiry, state guards and fencing.
R-LEASE-DIGEST.condition: Verify every producer issues cryptographically random 32-byte tokens; current contract is 64 lowercase hex and relevant claim code uses randomBytes(32).

R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.reason: Replace raw idempotency key with a versioned domain-separated HMAC digest; preserve actor/operation scope and replay conflict semantics.
R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.transform: HMAC-SHA-256 with versioned dedicated key and domain prefix flylink:d1:idempotency:v1
R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.condition: Migration runner and Worker must use the same versioned HMAC key via secret custody; no key in D1, source, logs, or Notion.

R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.reason: Treat provider event dedupe token as potentially replayable capability until provider contract proves it is a non-sensitive stable identifier.
R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.transform: HMAC-SHA-256 with versioned provider-event domain key
R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.condition: Provider contract may downgrade to opaque stable ID only with documented evidence.

R-METADATA-JSON.reason: JSON may contain PII, credentials, URLs, raw material or arbitrary free text; only a versioned recursive allowlist is permitted.
R-METADATA-JSON.transform: canonical JSON + field-specific versioned recursive allowlist; reject unknown and unsafe keys/values
R-METADATA-JSON.condition: Define exact JSON schema per field; assertNoUnsafeFields is not a whole-table guarantee.

R-CONTROLLED-JSON.reason: Snapshot or controlled policy JSON may be retained only under a versioned schema and strict allowlist.
R-CONTROLLED-JSON.transform: canonical JSON + schema validation + recursive secret/PII rejection

R-PUBLIC-JWK-DEFER.reason: Future passkey data is not active; public-key JWK only may be reconsidered later.
R-PUBLIC-JWK-DEFER.condition: Dedicated WebAuthn contract; allow public JWK members only and reject private member d.

R-ADS-CONDITIONAL.reason: Lazy feature-gated Ads Consent schema; not an unconditional part of the production source table set.
R-ADS-CONDITIONAL.condition: Require ADS_CLICK_BINDING_ENABLED and independently verified production presence; establish versioned baseline fingerprint first.

R-ARCHIVE-CONDITIONAL.reason: Legacy archive forms only when exact old platform_payment_orders schema fingerprint matches.
R-ARCHIVE-CONDITIONAL.condition: Include only if read-only inventory proves exact archive exists; build final D1 shape directly, never replay SQLite RENAME.

R-USAGE-CONDITIONAL.reason: Linkable usage behavior; do not copy an unbounded raw sample history.
R-USAGE-CONDITIONAL.condition: Require approved finite retention, query/workload justification and aggregation decision.

R-ORGANIZATION-CONDITIONAL.reason: May contain a company entity name or a natural person's name / sole-proprietor identifier.
R-ORGANIZATION-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only verified organization entity values; externalize natural-person or sole-proprietor identifying values.

R-REFERRAL-CODE-CONDITIONAL.reason: User-facing referral code may be a public opaque code or bearer-like capability.
R-REFERRAL-CODE-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only if generated opaque and not username/email or secret capability; otherwise store digest/reference.

R-SAFE-REASON-CONDITIONAL.reason: Field may contain free text; target accepts only safe enumerated reason/purpose codes.
R-SAFE-REASON-CONDITIONAL.condition: Require code allowlist and reject arbitrary text; otherwise transform to safe code or externalize raw text.

R-URL-EXT.reason: URLs may carry bearer tokens or signed query parameters.
R-URL-EXT.replacement: opaque short-lived URL/action reference; raw URL never in D1 or logs.

R-FREE-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.reason: Potential free text or identifying data.
R-FREE-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only a controlled enum/safe code; do not migrate arbitrary user text.

R-DIGEST-KEEP.reason: Already a digest/checksum field; verify algorithm, domain, canonicalization and absence of raw source value.

R-OPAQUE-REF-KEEP.reason: Retain only as opaque reference; reject email, username, URL, absolute path, bearer token, raw UUID/password or material.
R-OPAQUE-REF-KEEP.condition: Validate opaque reference grammar and ownership; re-issue stable opaque refs if source value is not opaque.

R-UNMAPPED-JSON-CONDITIONAL.reason: JSON semantics are not covered by the current explicit allowlist.
R-UNMAPPED-JSON-CONDITIONAL.condition: Do not include until field-specific versioned schema and recursive safe-value allowlist are documented.

R-TIME-KEEP.reason: Preserve source time representation; do not globally coerce text ISO timestamps to integers.
R-TIME-KEEP.condition: Preserve epoch-millisecond INTEGER where source type is INTEGER; otherwise validate canonical UTC ISO text and source precision.

R-BOOL-KEEP.reason: Keep SQLite INTEGER 0/1; preserve/add explicit CHECK (value IN (0,1)).

R-INTEGER-KEEP.reason: Keep INTEGER with safe-integer bounds and source-specific sign/range invariants.

R-ENUM-KEEP.reason: Keep TEXT only with exact enum/safe-code allowlist; reject unbounded free text.

R-CURATED-COPY-KEEP.reason: Curated operator-controlled product copy; validate length and reject secrets, URLs, PII and unsafe markup.

R-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.reason: Text semantics are not sufficiently constrained by a field-specific allowlist.
R-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only after domain owner confirms opaque reference, enum or safe bounded text contract.

R-PASSWORD-DEFER.reason: Password hash storage is a future capability; no production verifier rows are established.
R-PASSWORD-DEFER.condition: No rows migrate in target v1; empty schema inclusion is a separate DDL decision after password-auth hashing/reset/abuse-control approval.

R-PASSKEY-DEFER.reason: Real WebAuthn registration is not enabled; no production credential rows may be assumed.
R-PASSKEY-DEFER.condition: Defer schema and data until a dedicated WebAuthn contract is approved; future public-key-only material may be considered, never private keys.

designNotes: Raw lead email/message, subscription URL, encrypted TOTP blob, provider next-action URL, legacy checkout URL/QR and edge credential-material files remain outside D1.
All raw lease_token columns become lease_token_hash using SHA-256 with a domain prefix; generation, lease_until, state guards and fencing remain unchanged.
Raw idempotency keys become versioned domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 digests; key custody is a separate security design and no key is provisioned here.
metadata_json/event_json/payload_json are transformed via exact recursive allowlists; controlled snapshots/policies are kept only after schema validation.
Usage samples require finite retention/aggregation decision; Ads Consent and legacy archive remain conditional; password/passkey data remain deferred.
platform_schema_migrations and Wrangler d1_migrations coexist as separate ledgers; schemaDigest, not PRAGMA schema_version, is schema identity.
Payment remains multi-stage saga/reconciliation; subscription fulfillment crosses D1/BWH with durable command/receipt; Deferred remains single-D1 atomic + Lease/outbox.
blockers: Field map is a proposal; domain-owner review and final target-schema approval are pending.
Named accountable owners are not assigned; ownerDomain identifies source module only.
Production table presence, source values, row counts, DB size, WAL, workload and retention distributions remain NOT_OBSERVED.
Exact retention schedules remain unresolved for financial/audit records, sessions/challenges after expiry, usage samples and consent evidence.
Idempotency HMAC key custody/version/rotation is not designed or provisioned.
Field-specific JSON allowlists are not yet specified for every JSON field.
Opaque-reference grammar and historical value conformance have not been tested against production values.
Provider event_dedupe_key semantics require provider-contract evidence.

G2 accepted scope is local Wrangler/Miniflare plus synthetic data, not complete D1 equivalence; companion FK/deferred behavior, CHECK functions, partial indexes, batch/withSession bookmarks and concurrent pagination snapshot semantics require explicit testing.

18 historical migration checksums retain G1-28 runtime-recomputation provenance plus current-head diff review; this is not a 19/19 current-head runtime re-execution. Plan C checksum was independently recomputed.
